info.title: v2.ads.get_create_product_ad_budget_suggestion
info.description: Call this API to get budget suggestion for product ads creation

get.description: Call this API to get budget suggestion for product ads creation

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: bidding_method
parameters.description: Bidding Method of product ad: auto, manual

parameters.name: discovery_ads_location_names
parameters.description: List of comma separated location values from: daily_discover, you_may_also_like. Mandatory for product_selection=manual, product_placement={all|discovery}, bidding_method=manual

parameters.name: enhanced_cpc
parameters.description: Enhanced CPC functionality toggle. Values supported "true"/"false". Mandatory for product_selection=manual, bidding_method=manual

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: product_selection
parameters.description: auto,manual - for Auto product ads or Manual Product Ads

parameters.name: reference_id
parameters.description: A random string used to prevent duplicate ads. If an ads is created successfully, subsequent request using the same reference id will fail

parameters.name: roas_target
parameters.description: the ROAS target for each campaign with auto bidding. If 0, GMV Max / ROI feature is not enabled

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a shop. Required param for most APIs.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.

<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.test.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/ads/get_create_product_ad_budget_suggestion?access_token=access_token&bidding_method=manual&campaign_placement=all&discovery_ads_location_names=daily_discover%2Cyou_may_also_like&enhanced_cpc=true&item_id=112233&partner_id=partner_id&product_selection=auto&reference_id=asdf-1234-qwerty&roas_target=1.2&shop_id=shop_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'GET',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;
